sar.narrative: This report details suspected card-not-present fraud involving customer C09988 and card C09988-K1. On December 11, 2016, an unauthorized online transaction of $59.67 was conducted using the customer's card. The customer explicitly reported this transaction as unrecognized. The transaction was initiated from device D000431, profiled as a Windows system running Edge 16.0, which was new to the account. Graph analysis revealed that this specific device has been linked to 10 prior confirmed fraud cases. Additionally, during the same time period, device D000431 was used across 35 different cards, including four cards (C04965-K2, C07196-K2, C08374-K1, C09616-K1) that exhibited highly suspicious activity. The use of a known fraudulent device across multiple unrelated accounts indicates a coordinated effort to exploit compromised card information. The total exposure for this customer is $59.67.

stop_reason: The investigation stopped because the direct customer report combined with independent graph evidence of a known fraudulent device provided a decisive probability of fraud, satisfying policy section 6.
